entities.name: Spiridon Gopčević
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Spiridon Gopčević, also known under the pseudonym Leo Brenner, was a Serbian-Austrian amateur astronomer, journalist, writer and historian born in Trieste. His works on the modern history of Serbia and the Balkans were written from a nationalist point-of-view.
